name: SweetCookie
description: Run Minecraft Bedrock Edition Add-Ons on Minecraft Java Edition.

custom.sweetcookie:note: minecraftRange is filled in per node by processResources. Each jar is compiled against exactly one Minecraft version and pinned to it: the classes it calls do not exist on the other one, so a range spanning the 1.21.11/26.2 seam would let the mod load and then die. SC-220 section 6 keeps adding a version to settings.gradle.kts plus one buildscript entry. This sits under "custom" because Fabric Loader rejects unknown ROOT entries - it reported the previous _comment as an invalid entry on every launch.
